generation_rules: Look up products by canonical_name. This file contains retailer SKUs, not backend ingredient IDs, and is not loaded by AI extraction routes.
One purchased package costs unit_price_sgd. Multiply whole purchased packages by that price with Decimal; do not multiply package price by grams or millilitres.
Total as-sold contents equals purchased packages times contents_per_package. For example, two 1 kg packs provide 2 kg, not 2000 kg.
Preserve contents_unit in receipt text. For comparison only, 1 kg equals 1000 g and 1 l equals 1000 ml. Never invent piece-to-mass, mass-to-volume, cooked-yield or trim-yield conversions.
Do not multiply firm tofu's total pack mass by items_per_package. For eggs the primary contents already count individual eggs.
Cabbage needs measured head weight and canned chickpeas need verified drained weight before claiming recipe quantities are sufficient.

Promotional prices apply to one package at this snapshot date; their conditions and dates are recorded. For a later synthetic receipt date, use regular_price_sgd when the recorded promotion is inapplicable; do not claim it is a fresh live quote.

Retailer stock names can be used for synthetic receipt lines but are not claimed to be exact printed receipt descriptions. Any later abbreviation must be identified as derived in the generated batch records.
Ignore tap water for shopping coverage, but do not silently ignore other missing ingredients or assume pantry items are present without scenario configuration.
Save new receipt runs under ignored dataset/work/; explicitly select wanted images for dataset/receipt/generated/ and update receipt/manifest.json.
